text: OPAP's largest owner is Allwyn AG at 48.1% of the company. Allwyn is the rebranded Sazka Group, whose sole owner since 2019 is the Czech investment group KKCG, founded by Karel Komárek; no state or state-fund owner is named in either account.
short: OPAP's largest owner is Allwyn AG (48.1%), the rebranded Sazka Group, solely owned by Czech investment group KKCG.

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia: KKCG (KKCG becomes sole owner of Sazka Group, rebranded Allwyn; OPAP stake raised to 49.84%)
additionalSources.quote: In 2019, KKCG took over EMMA Capital's 25% of shares of Sazka Group for € 630 million, effectively becoming the sole owner of Sazka Group
